title: Run 152 re-measures the maintained gates on the unchanged frozen candidate. The external lab block is gone and the FREEZE-030/-040 real-cluster group is GREEN 23/23; packaged regression stays red 3/3 at 1/20; and the new hypothesis that the candidate is merely stale against an already-fixed source is FALSIFIED, which closes off every W57-internal remedy for the remaining red.

new_hypothesis_stale_candidate.hypothesis: The packaged gate is red only because the frozen artifact predates a source-level fix to the shutdown deadlock. If true, a rebuild would clear HPC-W10-PKGREG-001 and the blocker would be W57-owned freeze bookkeeping rather than a product defect.

measurements.result: exit 0 - bdf6c6c7 IS a reachable ancestor of HEAD on develop
(empty) - src/ is byte-identical between the candidate commit and HEAD
(empty) - the shell file has not been touched since the freeze

new_hypothesis_stale_candidate.why_it_matters: The frozen candidate faithfully represents current product source and the defect is still live in current source: frame.Hide() occurs exactly once in src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py, at line 1394, inside the close path that repair 162 pinned with py-spy on the frozen executable (close wx_shell.py:1394 called from finish wx_shell.py:2060, with app.ExitMainLoop() at wx_shell.py:2063 never reached). Therefore no rebuild can clear this red, and no amount of W57 freeze bookkeeping can clear it either. The only remedy is an owner fix in the shell/lifecycle surface, then an owner rebuild, then a rerun of the invalidated W56/W57 evidence.
new_hypothesis_stale_candidate.self_correction: My first read of git merge-base --is-ancestor in this dispatch was wrong: a throwaway wrapper mapped an empty stdout to the string no, which I initially misread as a nonzero exit. The explicit exit code is 0. The stale-candidate theory is falsified.

T02_candidate_commit.goal: Make the tested candidate content resolvable to a real Git commit so candidate_sha is not a dirty-tree fiction.
T02_candidate_commit.status: ALREADY SATISFIED BY REPOSITORY TRUTH - no commit was created in this dispatch.
evidence: git diff --stat bdf6c6c7 HEAD -- src/ -> empty
T02_candidate_commit.why_no_commit: The freeze identity is already bound to a real, reachable, 40-hex commit whose src/ tree is identical to HEAD, so the plan objective is met without writing history. The remaining dirty delta is not product: it is 3 modified files under .opencode/ (controller/Agent-Core surface) plus 6 untracked root-level Python files that are stale forks of the controller runtime (wave_state_engine.py, run-wave-program.py, route-wave-findings.py, wave_progress.py, parallel_workspace.py) plus one stray duplicate test. Committing controller WIP into product history is not a W57 action, and prior repairs 128/130/131 already established this delta is unattested core WIP. AGENTS.md also forbids push/tag/release/sign/publish without explicit current approval, and the accepted plan records that committing the dirty delta requires current approval, which this dispatch does not have. The delta is left byte-for-byte untouched and recorded.

T08_stray_root_duplicate.disposition: RECORDED, NOT DELETED. It is a byte-identical duplicate, but AGENTS.md forbids dropping unknown untracked user files, and the accepted plan directs that a refusal be recorded verbatim rather than worked around. It is collected by no gate this Wave runs, because every pytest invocation in this dispatch passed explicit file paths. A bare root-level pytest would double-collect it, which is the concrete impact.

wave_decision.owned_blocker: HPC-W10-PKGREG-001 - packaged regression on the candidate is red 3/3 at 1/20
wave_decision.why_reopen_not_blocked: No mandatory prerequisite is missing. The external lab is up and green 23/23, the candidate is a real reachable commit, and the artifact identity verifies without rebuild. The red is a measured, reproduced, repository-owned product defect.
wave_decision.why_reopen_not_human_deferred: No credential, MFA, operator authority, hardware, service or manual-acceptance step is unavailable. DEF-W57-006, the historical authority block, is resolved and was re-measured green in this dispatch.
wave_decision.why_reopen_not_ready_for_audit: An owned mandatory gate is red and no green freeze declaration can be issued. FREEZE-046 stays Frozen for W58: NO.
wave_decision.owner_route_verified_independently: The shutdown defect lives in src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py, the wx application shell and lifecycle surface. W55 is titled "Integrated shell, accessibility, DPI and lifecycle soak" and its Wave frontmatter owns HPC-W10-GJ2-024 through 054 plus HPC-W10-GOLDEN-JOURNEY-001, which is machine authority for that surface. This independently confirms the repair 163 owner-route correction to W55. W56 is titled "Real-cluster replay and candidate build" and owns only FREEZE and BUILD rows, so it is not the owner. W55 is CLOSED, so this needs a controller-owned closed-owner repair transaction; W57 must not patch the frozen candidate.
secondary_owner_routes: HPC-W04-HARNESS-025 and HPC-W04-FRESH-009 (W16 and W15, both CLOSED): the gate budget and evidence-discard path at scripts/wx_packaged_smoke.py lines 128 and 190-192, which converts a complete PASS payload into 1/20.
Controller and Agent-Core owner: tests/contracts/test_wave_closeout_hardening.py asserts a legacy AGENT_PARITY=PASS stdout token against an untracked, gitignored validator that now emits JSON.
W16 and W04 harness owner: tests/test_wx_packaged_smoke.py::test_workdir_outside_repo_excludes_repo_tmp asserts an expectation invalidated by the documented repo-root .tmp NTFS junction.
wave_decision.no_progress_note: This is a new content identity, not a restatement of the run-161 finding. Run 161 left the artifact shutdown open; repair 162 closed the mechanism with py-spy; this dispatch falsified the stale-candidate remedy, cleared the external block by fresh measurement, produced a green FREEZE-030/-040 binding under the current lab state, and surfaced two previously unreported seam defects.

T07b_w57_freeze_consistency.disposition: The W57-owned freeze-consistency seam is GREEN. The freeze declaration remains internally consistent with the current candidate, and the sole blocker is the red packaged gate, not freeze-declaration drift.
